panel.label: Building
panel.name: building_panel
panel.text: New prims made with the Build tool

check_box.label: Default size (m):
check_box.name: new_prim_size_enabled
check_box.tool_tip: Rez new prims at this size instead of 0.5 m

check_box.label: Phantom
check_box.name: new_prim_phantom
check_box.tool_tip: New prims do not collide with avatars or objects

check_box.label: Physical
check_box.name: new_prim_physical
check_box.tool_tip: New prims are moved by physics (they fall and can be pushed)

check_box.label: Temporary
check_box.name: new_prim_temporary
check_box.tool_tip: New prims are deleted automatically about a minute after they are made

texture_picker.label: Texture
texture_picker.name: new_prim_texture
texture_picker.tool_tip: Texture put on every face of new prims. Choose None to keep the standard plywood. Only copy + transfer textures can be chosen.

panel.text: Texture for every face of a new prim. None keeps the standard plywood. Only textures you can copy and transfer can be chosen.
Item put in every new prim:

sl_inventory_item_drop_target.name: new_prim_item
sl_inventory_item_drop_target.tool_tip: Drag an item you can copy here, usually a script. A copy of it is put in the Contents of every prim you make with the Build tool.

sl_inventory_item_drop_target.name: default_script_item
sl_inventory_item_drop_target.tool_tip: Drag a script you can copy and modify here. New Script, in your inventory and in an object's Contents, then makes a copy of it instead of the standard "Hello, Avatar!" script.

panel.text: New Script, in your inventory and in an object's Contents, makes a copy of this script instead of the standard one. In an object the copy keeps the script's own name.

combo_box.name: selection_style_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: How selected objects are outlined while editing. Classic: LL's glowing silhouette on prims and sculpties, Firestorm's soft wireframe on mesh and avatars. Outline: a clean outline of everything, with the visible edges of each face. Wireframe: every triangle edge.
